title: The 144,000 of Israel Sealed, A Great Multitude

questions.question: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four ____ of the earth, that no ____ might blow on earth or sea or against any tree.
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:1 (ESV): "After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth, that no wind might blow on earth or sea or against any tree."

questions.question: Then I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, with the ____ of the living God, and he called with a loud voice to the four angels...
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:2 (ESV): "Then I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, with the seal of the living God, and he called with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm earth and sea,"

questions.question: saying, "Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God on their ____."
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:3 (ESV): "saying, 'Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.'"

questions.question: And I heard the number of the sealed, ____, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:4 (ESV): "And I heard the number of the sealed, 144,000, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:"

questions.question: How many were sealed from each of the twelve tribes?
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:5-8 (ESV) lists twelve tribes, stating "12,000 sealed from the tribe of [Name]" for each.

questions.question: Which of these tribes is NOT listed among those sealed in Revelation 7?
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:5-8 lists Judah, Reuben, Gad, Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Simeon, Levi, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, and Benjamin. Dan is noticeably absent.

questions.question: After this I looked, and behold, a great ____ that no one could number, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages...
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:9 (ESV): "After this I looked, and behold, a great multitude that no one could number, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands,"

questions.question: What were the great multitude holding in their hands?
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:9 (ESV): "...clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands,"

questions.question: and crying out with a loud voice, "____ belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:10 (ESV): "and crying out with a loud voice, 'Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!'"

questions.question: And all the ____ were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:11 (ESV): "And all the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,"

questions.question: saying, "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God ____ and ____! Amen."
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:12 (ESV): "saying, 'Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God forever and ever! Amen.'"

questions.question: Then one of the elders addressed me, saying, "Who are these, clothed in ____ robes, and from where have they come?"
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:13 (ESV): "Then one of the elders addressed me, saying, 'Who are these, clothed in white robes, and from where have they come?'"

questions.question: I said to him, "Sir, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones coming out of the great ____. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb."
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:14 (ESV): "I said to him, 'Sir, you know.' And he said to me, 'These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.'"

questions.question: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any scorching heat. For the Lamb in the midst of the throne will be their ____...
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:16-17 (ESV): "They shall hunger no more, neither thirst anymore; the sun shall not strike them, nor any scorching heat. For the Lamb in the midst of the throne will be their shepherd..."

questions.question: ...and he will guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every ____ from their eyes.
questions.explanation: Revelation 7:17 (ESV): "For the Lamb in the midst of the throne will be their shepherd, and he will guide them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."

key_verse_text: I said to him, "Sir, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb."
